newsitem.title: USA: Delta to suspend Wilkes-Barre/Cincinnati service.
newsitem.headline: Delta to suspend Wilkes-Barre/Cincinnati service.

text.p: SCRANTON, Pa., Jan. 7 - Delta Air Lines said Tuesday it will suspend service between Cincinnati and Wilkes-Barre/Scranton International Airport on March 2.
Wilkes-Barre/Scranton will continue to be served by Delta Connection carrier, Comair, with nonstop flights to Delta's hub at Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport.
Comair will operate three flights daily between Wilkes-Barre/Scranton and Cincinnati beginning March 2 featuring the Canadair Jet.

Delta said it does not suspend service without giving great consideration to the impact on the communities involved, but the airline said it must focus its resources on those markets where it can be most competitive and realize the greatest revenue generation opportunities.
